name: University of Victoria
header:
University of Victoria
Canada · Mathematics MSc; exceptional direct-entry PhD
Rank verification is maintained separately.
Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Research fit is concentrated: Scully is the closest verified algebraic/arithmetic-geometry match;
operator-algebra/quantum-group entries are adjacent interests. Asmita Sodhi is Assistant Teaching Professor;
Hari Srivastava and Ian Putnam are emeriti, not ordinary prospective research advisers.
• MSc is the normal bachelor’s-entry route; direct PhD needs explicit exceptional approval. Funding is
offer-specific, with no verified department-wide stipend guarantee.
• Faculty below form a verified research-fit shortlist, not a complete census. New-student supervision and 2027
leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Conflict]
MSc: completed four-year mathematics bachelor’s and at least B over the last two years. Direct PhD is
exceptional: department permits outstanding bachelor’s applicants; central rule allows consideration at A−
over the last two years, although PhD program summary says master’s required. Ask the graduate adviser
which route to select. International applicants accepted; UChicago degree does not itself establish required
grades. [admit] [central] [phd]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Choose pure mathematics; prepare transcripts, CV, personal statement and at least two assessors. Contact
compatible potential supervisors before applying: a supervisor able to provide funding is a major admission
factor, although securing one is not a formal prerequisite. [check]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Contact compatible faculty in advance to discuss supervision and funding; not mandatory to secure supervisor
before applying. Department contact: gradasstms@uvic.ca. [msc] [check]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Upload through application, not unsolicited email. After application UVic emails student number/status-check
instructions. Referee status and reminders are available inside assessment section. [docs] [apply]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing rules retrieved November 5, 2026; department deadline table does not name the 2027 cycle. Explicit
2027 admission/funding dates remain to be reconfirmed. [dates]

sections.title: Deadlines by stage
sections.text:
Academic application [Standing rule]
Standing September-entry final deadline: May 31; January-entry final: September 30. No explicit 2027 year or
time zone published. These later dates are for applicants not seeking funding. [dates]
Funding consideration [Standing rule]
Standing September-entry funding deadline January 31; January-entry funding deadline May 31, for domestic
and international applicants. No explicit 2027 cycle or time zone. [dates]

Reference receipt [Unresolved]

invitations follow submission, submit early enough for reports by the applicable funding deadline; this is
planning advice, not a verified separate deadline. [dates] [docs]

Supporting documents [Standing rule]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
If testing is needed: TOEFL after January 21, 2026 minimum 4.5, each 4; older scale 90, each 20. IELTS
Academic 6.5, each 6; CAEL 70/60; Cambridge 180/170; MET 64/60; PTE 65/60. Tests valid two years; TOEFL
home edition/MyBest and IELTS online/One Skill Retake accepted. Department adopts central standard. [english]
[admit]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
A completed degree taught in English at a recognized institution satisfies proficiency, so completed UChicago
bachelor’s qualifies by inference. The page does not explicitly address waiver approval while that degree is still
in progress; confirm before foregoing testing. [english]
GRE General; GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Not compulsory: program page strongly encourages submission of GRE General and Mathematics Subject
scores in its international-requirements branch; department checklist calls GRE supporting material. Confirm
that branch’s applicability to an international citizen with a U.S. degree. [msc] [check]

sections.title: Recommendation letters
sections.text:
Number and type [Standing rule]
At least two assessment reports; provide names and emails. Prefer academic assessors familiar with
mathematical preparation; professional references are accepted only where the program permits. [check] [docs]
Scholarship references [Standing rule]
No additional reference specified for supervisor-nominated UVic fellowships. External award references have
separate rules; incoming non-Canadian students are ineligible for CGRS-M and must already be registered in an
eligible Canadian doctorate to apply for international CGRS-D. [fund]

What sends the invitation [Standing rule]
UVic sends the assessment request after application submission, not merely on entering names. [docs]
Before versus after submission [Standing rule]
Yes; electronic requests follow submission. [docs]
Receipt confirmation [Standing rule]
Application assessment section shows report status; referee information can be changed and requests resent.
[docs]
Updating and reusing letters [Standing rule]
New application requires new assessments, including a second program. Referee-details editing/resending is
supported; replacement of an already submitted report is not publicly explained. [docs]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Unresolved]
No universal stipend figure or tuition/fees/insurance remission promise published. Department says individual
funding varies and is stated in admission offer; obtain an itemized CAD amount, covered months and
deductions. [fund]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Guaranteed support duration not publicly established; typical degree lengths (MSc two years, PhD three-four)
are not funding guarantees. [msc] [phd]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students can be considered for department support by the same funding deadline. Employment
requires Canadian work authorization; U.S. F-1 status does not establish that authorization. Individual award
eligibility varies. [dates] [fund]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
Support may combine supervisor grants, faculty awards and TA work. TA positions require application and
depend on vacancies and departmental needs; sessional appointments have separate qualifications. Exact
workload and guaranteed summer coverage unverified. [fund]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Faculty awards are supervisor-nominated. TA hiring has separate applications and deadlines; ask graduate
adviser for the 2027 timetable. [fund]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
Other avenues: graduate co-op, Mitacs research internships/visits and PIMS activity support, subject to
eligibility and supervisor approval. CGRS-M CAD 27,000/12 months is citizenship-restricted; CGRS-D CAD
40,000/year for three years has an already-enrolled requirement for international applicants. [fund]
Application fee [Standing rule]
CAD 187 because UChicago documents originate outside Canada; CAD 145.25 applies only when all documents
originate in Canada. Pay online by credit card; processing awaits payment. [apply]
Fee waiver [Unresolved]
No mathematics-specific or general applicable waiver procedure found after targeted searches. Another
department’s no-waiver statement is not treated as a math policy; ask gradasstms@uvic.ca before paying.
[apply]

sections.title: Conflicts and remaining checks
sections.text:
Conflicting sources [Conflict]
Program summary states master’s needed for PhD, but department and central policy allow exceptional
bachelor’s direct entry. Central generic advice to find a supervisor before applying is qualified by mathematics’
explicit no-prerequisite rule. GRE international branch is more encouraging than the
optional-supporting-material checklist. [phd] [admit] [central] [msc] [check]
Checks still needed [Unresolved]
Ask graduate adviser about exceptional direct PhD versus MSc; 2027 dates/time zone; reference grace period;
in-progress UChicago English waiver; statement prompt/limit; GRE branch; fee waiver; net funding and years;
supervisor availability. [dates] [check] [english] [fund]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Algebraic / arithmetic geometry
Stephen Scully
Quadratic and hermitian forms, projective homogeneous varieties, algebraic cycles, Chow motives and Milnor
K-theory. [faculty1] [faculty1a]
Associate Professor; current official page confirms appointment. New-student supervision unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 · Rationality of cycles modulo 2 on products of generically smooth quadrics in characteristic 2
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Number theory
Marcelo Laca
Operator-algebraic and noncommutative-geometric connections to number theory, Bost-Connes systems and
equilibrium states; adjacent to arithmetic geometry rather than a conventional arithmetic-geometry group.
[faculty3] [faculty3a]
Professor; recent paper verified with publisher after official faculty page research review. New-student supervision unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Crystallization of C*-Algebras
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Benjamin Anderson-Sackaney
Quantum groups, their representations and operator algebras; noncommutative dynamics and boundary
actions. [faculty5] [faculty5a]
Assistant Professor; new-student supervision unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2026 preprint · Furstenberg discretization with moment control and entropy rigidity
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
